text: A bald man with a white beard sits on a throne, wearing red tunic and pants with gold belts and arm cuffs. His face is weathered, eyes narrowed. To his left stands a muscular figure in red loincloth and boots, arms crossed, dark hair shoulder-length. Three hooded figures in purple cloaks stand to the right, backs turned. The seated man appears to be addressing or confronting the others. Background suggests a cavernous, dimly lit chamber with stone pillars.
